Why GPL-3.0
-----------
The SKSE plugin (BeeingFemale.dll) is built on CommonLibSSE-NG
(https://github.com/alandtse/CommonLibSSE-NG), which is GPL-3.0 licensed, so
Beeing Female NG is distributed under the same terms. The complete
corresponding source - C++ and Papyrus - is in the GitHub repository linked
above; the Papyrus sources also ship in this download under
Data\source\scripts.

Credits
-------
Beeing Female NG continues Beeing Female by milzschnitte. See the Credits
section of the mod page for the full list.
